user.title: Connect to Tesira
user.description: Enter the SSH connection details for the Tesira Text Protocol (TTP) server on your device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Tesira over SSH. Check the host, port, and credentials.

add_preset.title: Add a manual preset
add_preset.description: Presets discovered automatically come from Preset Button blocks in the Tesira design. Use this to add a preset that doesn't have one. Leave Preset ID blank to recall by name instead.
